discovery_policy: Do not use broad literature discovery as the primary workstream. Use targeted repository requests, author requests, or experimental collaboration.
failure_policy: Attempt one bounded correction for an isolated acquisition or schema problem; if unresolved, record it, skip it, and continue. HTTP 404 responses are not retried in the same cycle.

workstreams.unblock_when: All frozen temporal, license, exact-construct, saturation, provenance, exact-overlap, and MMseqs gates pass and the final record list is frozen.
priority_requests: Purdue Cdc14 deposited workbooks and construct files
authors of already audited zero-hit families with unresolved exact constructs or saturation evidence
new experimental collaboration spanning at least five unrelated families

workstreams.unblock_when: A permission-compatible direct experimental Km corpus supplies original linear values and units, row-level measurement provenance, exact sequences and structures, aggregation membership, and a frozen family-aware split.
priority_requests: Kroll/BRENDA source-row export and original frozen split
SABIO-RK independent rows with stable accessions and licensing evidence

workstreams.unblock_when: Enough direct measurements share an explicit canonical physical unit and denominator, exact constructs, defined substrates, compatible assay semantics, row-level provenance, and multiple family-aware partitions.
prohibited_shortcuts: EnzEngDB fitness as an absolute label

workstreams.unblock_when: Experimental flux rows provide reaction mapping, strain, medium, condition, method, canonical units, uncertainty, model mapping, and provenance; family/condition splits and target-leakage checks are frozen.
workstreams.claim_boundary: The existing FBA smoke is simulated and cannot unblock experimental flux.

workstreams.unblock_when: An independent custodian supplies complete unobserved campaign rosters; readiness and checkpoints are frozen before labels; blind predictions are deposited; labels are exposed once; one evaluation receipt is produced.
